banner.title: Extend with capabilities
banner.description: This page lists skills and connectors. Pick what you want to accomplish and add it in one click to use it in chat.

searchAdd.title: Search and add
searchAdd.description: Search to find a capability quickly, or use Add to import a local Skill / plugin or configure an MCP connector.

scope.title: Public / Personal
scope.description: Public browses available capabilities and Astravia built-in abilities. Personal manages universal skills and manually installed capabilities — enable, configure, or remove.

list.title: Capability cards
list.description: Each card is one capability. View details, add or enable it; you will be prompted when credentials are required.

create-skill.name: Create Skill
create-skill.description: Create or update an Agent Skill that follows the Astravia spec: place the files, register it in skills-manifest.json, or update the plugin config.

install-ability.name: Install Ability
install-ability.description: Install plugins, Skills, and MCP servers into this machine's Astravia, reloading right away when a plugin upgrade leaves a pending version.

publish-ability.name: Publish Ability
publish-ability.description: Submit a skill, MCP server, plugin, or ability bundle to the Astravia marketplace, covering required fields, localization, and the review flow.
